text:
JUDGE BURST K2c-jdg-01 — the Keeper's H1 8-direction turnaround (Run C-3 P2): equipment GEOMETRY verified by occlusion and anatomy, not by claim. task_id "K2c-jdg-01". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 = the APPROVED MASTER (direction S, facing the camera): the staff is in her RIGHT hand (on SCREEN-LEFT when she faces you); ONE strap runs from her RIGHT shoulder across the chest front to an olive satchel AT HER SIDE on her LEFT hip (screen-right). THE RULE you verify for every view: a figure turned toward screen-RIGHT shows her RIGHT side (the staff side) to the camera; turned toward screen-LEFT she shows her LEFT side (the satchel side). A figure whose visible near arm is EMPTY while the staff is held by the far arm, when the rule says the staff side is near, is a MIRRORED body (and vice-versa). Judge each candidate independently against ITS claimed direction; do not assume any candidate is a control and do not assume any candidate is correct.

Image 2 claims SW. EXPECTED for SW: she is turned 45° toward SCREEN-LEFT from the S pose — body, chest AND head all face the viewer's LOWER-LEFT (the previous attempt turned the head the other way: the head must turn WITH the body, toward screen-left). Her LEFT side is nearer the camera: the olive satchel hangs AT HER SIDE on her near LEFT hip, on the SCREEN-RIGHT of her body, nearest the camera; the strap runs from her far RIGHT shoulder diagonally across the FRONT of her chest down to that satchel. Her RIGHT arm holds the staff upright on the FAR side, on the SCREEN-LEFT of her body, partly behind her, the staff tip rising above her far shoulder. Face visible in three-quarter view, looking toward the screen's lower-left, head level.
Image 3 claims W. EXPECTED for W: full LEFT profile — she faces SCREEN-LEFT (nose, chest and boot toes point screen-left). Her LEFT side is toward the camera: the olive satchel hangs AT HER SIDE on her near LEFT hip, over the hip and upper thigh — not swung round to the front; the strap EMERGES FROM BEHIND HER NECK (from the far right shoulder) and runs diagonally down the FRONT of her chest to that satchel; her visible near LEFT shoulder is BARE (no strap over it); her near LEFT arm hangs relaxed with its laced bracer. Her RIGHT arm holds the staff on the FAR side, behind her body — the shaft mostly hidden behind her, its tip rising above her far shoulder and its foot showing beside her far boot. Face in left profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-left.
Image 4 claims NW. EXPECTED for NW: a BACK three-quarter view — she faces the viewer's UPPER-LEFT, turned 135° from the S pose, walking away from the camera toward screen-left. Her BACK and her LEFT side are visible; her LEFT side is nearer the camera: the olive satchel hangs AT HER SIDE on her near LEFT hip, on the SCREEN-LEFT, nearest the camera; the strap crosses her BACK diagonally from her far RIGHT shoulder (screen-right) down to that satchel. Her RIGHT arm holds the staff upright on the FAR side, on the SCREEN-RIGHT, behind her, the staff tip above her far shoulder. Her head is turned AWAY toward the upper-left — the face is NOT visible (at most the edge of a cheek and an ear), the tied-back curly hair visible; head level.
Image 5 claims E. EXPECTED for E: full RIGHT profile — she faces SCREEN-RIGHT (nose, chest and boot toes point screen-right). Her RIGHT side is toward the camera: her near RIGHT arm holds the staff upright IN FRONT of her body, nearest the camera, the gripping hand at chest height, the forearm and bracer fully visible, the staff's foot on the ground beside her near boot and its tip above her head; the strap passes over her visible near RIGHT shoulder and runs diagonally down the FRONT of her chest toward screen-right to the olive satchel on her FAR LEFT hip, which is on the far side, mostly hidden behind her body (at most a corner of it showing behind her hip). Her far LEFT arm hangs relaxed behind her body, mostly hidden. Face in right profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-right. CAUTION (the previous E attempt was MIRRORED): the staff is NOT in the far hand, and the empty arm is NOT the near arm.
Image 6 claims N. EXPECTED for N: a full BACK view — she faces directly AWAY from the camera (her back to the viewer). Her RIGHT hand, and the staff held upright in it, are on the SCREEN-RIGHT; the olive satchel hangs AT HER SIDE on her LEFT hip, on the SCREEN-LEFT; the single strap crosses her BACK diagonally from her RIGHT shoulder (screen-right, top) down to the satchel on her LEFT hip (screen-left, bottom). The face is NOT visible; the back of her head with the tied-back dark curly hair is; head level. The tabard's plain back panel, the belt, both bracers and the backs of both boots are visible.
Image 7 claims NE. EXPECTED for NE: a BACK three-quarter view — she faces the viewer's UPPER-RIGHT, turned 135° from the S pose, walking away from the camera toward screen-right. Her BACK and her RIGHT side are visible; her RIGHT side is nearer the camera: her RIGHT arm holds the staff upright on the SCREEN-RIGHT, NEAREST the camera, the gripping forearm in front of her body's contour; the strap crosses her BACK diagonally from her near RIGHT shoulder down to the olive satchel on her FAR LEFT hip, on the SCREEN-LEFT, mostly hidden behind her body. Her head is turned AWAY toward the upper-right — the face is NOT visible (at most the edge of a cheek and an ear), the tied-back curly hair visible; head level.
Image 8 claims E. EXPECTED for E: full RIGHT profile — she faces SCREEN-RIGHT (nose, chest and boot toes point screen-right). Her RIGHT side is toward the camera: her near RIGHT arm holds the staff upright IN FRONT of her body, nearest the camera, the gripping hand at chest height, the forearm and bracer fully visible, the staff's foot on the ground beside her near boot and its tip above her head; the strap passes over her visible near RIGHT shoulder and runs diagonally down the FRONT of her chest toward screen-right to the olive satchel on her FAR LEFT hip, which is on the far side, mostly hidden behind her body (at most a corner of it showing behind her hip). Her far LEFT arm hangs relaxed behind her body, mostly hidden. Face in right profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-right. CAUTION (the previous E attempt was MIRRORED): the staff is NOT in the far hand, and the empty arm is NOT the near arm.
Image 9 claims SE. EXPECTED for SE: she is turned 45° toward SCREEN-RIGHT from the S pose — body, chest and head all face the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT. Her RIGHT side is nearer the camera: her RIGHT arm holds the staff upright IN FRONT, on the SCREEN-LEFT of her body, nearest the camera, the gripping hand and bracer in front of the torso's contour; the strap runs from her near RIGHT shoulder diagonally across the FRONT of her chest down to the olive satchel on her FAR LEFT hip, on the SCREEN-RIGHT of her body, partly behind her. Face visible in three-quarter view, looking toward the screen's lower-right, head level.

For EACH candidate write, each with one line of visible evidence: seen_facing (one of S SW W NW N NE E SE); staff_side = "near" | "far" | "screen-left" | "screen-right" (back views) | "cannot tell" + the occlusion evidence (which arm's shoulder/forearm is in front of the torso); satchel = "near-side" | "far-side" | "front-of-body" | "absent"; strap = where it runs (over which visible shoulder; chest front or back); face_visible true|false; head_level true|false (false if looking down or turned against the body); mirrored true|false (anatomical right/left swapped relative to Image 1); then axes 1–5 (integers, one-line reasons): 1 register fidelity to Image 1 (hand-drawn tapered contour, painted planes) · 2 identity fidelity (face where visible, hair mass, costume, colours, plain surfaces) · 3 light (key from screen upper-left in every direction; lit from upper-right ≤ 2) · 4 equipment geometry vs the EXPECTED text for its claim (staff side, satchel side, strap path, face visibility — all correct = 5; each error −1; a mirrored body = 1) · 5 direction read (the claimed facing is unmistakable at 64 px tall).
Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":n,"claimed":"…","seen_facing":"…","staff_side":"…","staff_evidence":"…","satchel":"…","strap":"…","face_visible":bool,"head_level":bool,"mirrored":bool,"axes":{"1":n,"2":n,"3":n,"4":n,"5":n},"reasons":{"1":"…",…}}, …]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K2c-jdg-01"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — scores only.
